other_conditions: Must be an Indian student who has completed the 2nd year and written the examination to enter the 3rd year, or is studying in the 3rd year of a three‑year degree course, or is in the 4th year having written the examination to enter the 5th year, or is studying in the 5th year of a five‑year degree course.
Internship is full‑time and must be attended physically.
A minimum of 90% attendance is mandatory for satisfactory completion.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a ₹5,000 honorarium upon completion along with a certificate of internship.
